description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CandidateSearchFilterParams' used in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. The class encapsulates filter parameters for searching candidates with various properties and default sorting behavior.

classes.name: CandidateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams to encapsulate various candidate search filters, including IDs, status, date ranges, keywords, and sorting preferences.
